{{Quote|Dash-1044 isn't responding, Sir. Nor is Nin&mdash;I mean, Dash-1129.|[[Unidentified clone trooper sergeant (Malastare)|A clone sergeant]], to [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]|<ref name="Dug Out" />}}
'''Four-Four''', designated '''Dash-1044''', was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Droids'' didn't do this. There's something ''else'' out here. On your guard.|[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], upon seeing the body of Dash-1044|<ref name="Dug Out" />}}
Dash-1044 was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who later adopted the name Four-Four. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Dash-1044 took part in a [[Mission to Malastare (Clone Wars)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by primitive [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]].<ref name="Dug Out" /> Four-Four was a clone trooper who served in a mission to Malastare during the Clone Wars. He was found dead.
